body.statement: The language of unsatisfiable Boolean formulas in \(3\)-CNF is \(\mathsf{coNP}\)-complete under polynomial many-one reductions.

source.locator: Section 3, paragraph after Definition 3 on page 3, and the 3-SAT hardness use in the proof of Lemma 1 on page 8
source.verbatim_statement: Satisfiability (U = L) is SSP-NP-complete even when all clauses are restricted to length three.

upstream.citation: Craig A. Tovey. A simplified NP-complete satisfiability problem. Discrete Applied Mathematics 8(1):85--89, 1984. DOI: 10.1016/0166-218X(84)90081-7.

attestation.note: Verified against Grüne and Wulf, The Complexity of Blocking All Solutions, arXiv:2502.05348v1, Lemma 17 proof, p. 22 of the arXiv PDF. This is the 3-CNF satisfiability NP-completeness premise; taking the complement yields 3-CNF UNSAT coNP-completeness under the same polynomial many-one reductions. Open author-posted arXiv copy retrieved 2026-09-16.
